answer: Wharf-lottery assignment: each epoch, a VRF seeded by an unpredictable beacon assigns agents to shards (wharf slots) and audit duties. Attackers cannot precompute placements, so splitting one identity into many yields uncorrelated assignments, triggering ripple audits when synthetic agents cluster oddly. Juniper nonce logging makes equivocation detectable. Cost: mass identity creation plus losing assigned audits, while each sybil gains only random, non-amplifying influence.
